gates.fresh_problem: Given multiple prior pairwise UI decisions across Doré surfaces, infer only context-near preferences. Refuse to produce a global aesthetic rule when evidence is sparse, contradictory, or limited to one surface family.
acceptance: preference is expressed relationally rather than as an absolute taste score
single-surface evidence is not promoted globally
gates.next_action: Use the contextual preference field to predict one real A/B design choice and compare the prediction with an observed decision.

gates.fresh_problem: Find a Doré design decision where historical preference evidence is weak or contradictory. Estimate confidence, explain the uncertainty source, and choose whether to explore, defer, or use a precedent.
acceptance: confidence is not inferred from model prose alone
the system can return uncertain rather than force a winner
gates.next_action: Collect the minimum additional comparison needed to resolve or preserve the uncertainty.

gates.fresh_problem: Select the next most informative pairwise UI comparison from several possible alternatives. Prefer close-strength, under-observed, or contradiction-prone pairs rather than arbitrary additional comparisons.
gates.next_action: Run the selected comparison and verify whether it reduces uncertainty or reveals a context split.

gates.fresh_problem: Handle a new design result that contradicts a high-confidence precedent. Determine whether the prior rule was overgeneralized, the context signature was too coarse, the product identity changed, or the new case is a legitimate local art-direction exception.
acceptance: contradiction is preserved rather than averaged away
at least two competing explanations are considered
context resegmentation is attempted before global reversal
gates.next_action: Split or supersede the affected preference scope only if the evidence supports it.

gates.fresh_problem: Compress a mature set of Doré design precedents into the smallest useful runtime preference pack without copying the full history. Keep no more than three stable claims, two rejection precedents, and one uncertainty warning, with evidence ids retained.
acceptance: stable and uncertain claims are separated
prompt size decreases as evidence grows
gates.next_action: Use the compressed pack on a fresh surface and compare its decision quality with an unbounded-history baseline.

gates.fresh_problem: On a new Doré surface, retrieve a bounded preference pack, decide whether precedent is strong enough to guide the design, generate alternatives when uncertainty is material, request one high-information comparison if needed, and either preserve or revise the learned preference after observing the result.
acceptance: no universal aesthetic score is created

gates.next_action: Promote the preference field to a reusable Doré Design capability only after a blind new-surface graduation pass.
